title: Locality of approximate tangent spaces (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(2))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and A ⊆ B ⊆ U Borel sets with Hⁿ(B ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ A and every linear subspace Q of ℝ^P: B has approximate tangent space Q at x if and only if A has approximate tangent space Q at x. Here 'E has approximate tangent space Q at x' is Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 as formalized by HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n E x Q: dim Q = n and ∫_{η_{x,λ}(E)} f dHⁿ → ∫_Q f dHⁿ as λ ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), where η_{x,λ}(z) = λ⁻¹(z − x) (SimonGMT blowUpMap).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q
